answer: Reaching eligibility takes 56 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. The quartz register is checked at draw time, anchor lists the eligible set, and echo seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 56 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Each copy needs 2 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
